The variable `f` is created by calling `FileUtils.resolveFile( dir, entryName )` where `dir` is the second parameter of the method (also a File). The `srcF` parameter (line 1) is never used in the creation of `f` at line 7. The value of `f` is determined solely by the `dir` parameter and `entryName` parameter, not by `srcF`.

Looking at the rest of the code, `f` is used at line 36 in `new FileOutputStream( f )`, but since `f` was already computed from `dir` and `entryName` without involving `srcF`, the value of `f` used at line 36 does not depend on the value of the `srcF` parameter at line 1.
